name: [Loaded Potato] Signal Linked Device URI Invocation
description: Detects any process launched with a Signal linked-device URI (sgnl://linkdevice) on its command line. Legitimate Signal device-linking is initiated by Signal Desktop generating a QR code that the mobile app scans - the URI is never sent inbound to a victim and is never passed as a command-line argument to Signal.exe in normal flow. Any cmdline match indicates a credential-phishing-page-triggered protocol-handler invocation, script-driven device-link abuse, or manual paste of an attacker-supplied URI. Covers GTIG-disclosed UNC5792/UNC4221 Signal account takeover (Feb 2025) but generic across all actors targeting Signal device-linking. MITRE: T1098.005 Account Manipulation: Device Registration.
author: Loaded Potato

name: [Loaded Potato] Signal Desktop Data Access by Non-Signal Process
description: Detects non-Signal processes referencing Signal Desktop data paths on the command line - the encrypted SQLite database (sql/db.sqlite), the config.json holding the database encryption key, or the broader AppData/Roaming/Signal tree. Catches the WAVESIGN batch script family, robocopy/xcopy exfil patterns (e.g. UNC1151 'robocopy ...\Signal /S'), PowerShell file enumeration (e.g. Turla 'Get-ChildItem ...\SIGNAL\config.json'), and arbitrary copy/type/cat commands targeting Signal user data. Excludes Signal.exe itself and Signal's auto-updater. Generic across actor - any Signal data exfil this way triggers. MITRE: T1005 + T1552.001 (Credentials In Files - config.json holds the DB key).
query: process.command_line: (*\\Signal\\config.json* OR *\\Signal\\sql\\db.sqlite* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Signal\\*) AND NOT process.executable: (*\\Signal.exe OR *\\Update.exe OR *\\Signal Desktop\\*)
author: Loaded Potato

name: [Loaded Potato] PowerShell Enumerating Signal Desktop User Data
description: Narrower high-fidelity variant focused on PowerShell as the access vector. Detects powershell.exe or pwsh.exe with a command line referencing Signal Desktop internal directories (config, sql, sessions, attachments.noindex). Matches the GTIG-documented Turla TTP 'Get-ChildItem ...\SIGNAL\config.json' and similar Get-Content / Copy-Item enumeration of the Signal data tree. Does not catch base64-encoded variants - pair with a script-block-logging rule for those. MITRE: T1059.001 PowerShell + T1083 File and Directory Discovery.
query: process.name: (powershell.exe OR pwsh.exe) AND process.command_line: (*Signal\\config* OR *Signal\\sql* OR *Signal\\sessions* OR *Signal\\attachments.noindex* OR *SIGNAL\\config* OR *SIGNAL\\sql*)
author: Loaded Potato

name: [Loaded Potato] Connection to Known Signal-Targeting Phishing Infrastructure
description: Alerts on outbound DNS, URL, or TLS-SNI traffic to any of the 26 phishing domains publicly attributed to Russia-aligned Signal-account-takeover campaigns (UNC5792 + UNC4221 per GTIG/Mandiant Feb 2025; corroborated by Threadlinqs Feb 2026 + Eventus Security May 2025). Each is a typosquat/spoof of Signal's UI (signal-group*, signal-security*, signal-confirm*, signal-protect*) or a Kropyva-themed lure (teneta.*, kropyva.*). Should be paired with the URI invocation rule above - DNS for these is a precursor to the device-link payload. Refresh this list as new GTIG/CERT-UA reports drop. MITRE: T1566.002 Spearphishing Link + T1583.001 Acquire Infrastructure: Domains.
